name: 24511-visionarena-qwen25vl7b-1gpu
hardware: 1x H100 80GB HBM3 (one GPU of an a3 node, --gres=gpu:1).
parallelism: TP=1, PP=1, DP=1: one engine on one GPU.
architecture: Qwen2_5_VLForConditionalGeneration, bf16. Decoder 28 layers, 4 KV heads, head_dim 128 -> 56 KiB of KV per token; the rest is in the checkpoint's own config.json and preprocessor_config.json.
load_profile: concurrent (CLOSED loop), streams=100, warmup the first 20% by completion, bounded at 1000 requests with a 900 s safety cap.
workload: Real image+text chat traffic, ONE image per request, one turn, ONE token out, from `lmarena-ai/VisionArena-Chat` as a prepared 1000-row local copy at `data/visionarena-chat-1000` (columns `prompt`, `images` as a scalar image feature, `output_tokens_count` 1; streaming shuffle at seed 40, first 1000 rows). Images 137x137 to 1024x1024, 769 distinct resolutions, median 505881 pixels; prompt text median 9 tokens, mean 100.2, max 15565. temperature 0.0.
purpose: A vision chat assistant answering single-image questions for 100 concurrent users on one GPU.
launch:
# Engine launch line: commit 3e903b6cb4292ca1425a37cb809c1e3cddfdadcb (v0.10.2rc2-52-g3e903b6cb429).

model: Qwen/Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct
trust-remote-code: true          # required by this checkpoint
tensor-parallel-size: 1
dtype: bfloat16
max-model-len: 128000

# Pinned deliberately: these are what a `vllm serve` entry point resolves to on a GPU of this
# class at this commit. Constructing the engine in-process resolves 128 and 5120 instead, which
# is a different machine -- do not drop these two lines.
max-num-seqs: 1024
max-num-batched-tokens: 8192

enable-prefix-caching: true
gpu-memory-utilization: 0.90
